purpose: Select one reproducible open-source application for FFT, FWHT, and NTT. This manifest is a preparation contract, not a result table.

entry_points.role: Official end-to-end training, evaluation, and resolution-transfer example; the high-resolution payload uses the same package DarcyDataset contract.

baseline.name: pinned_neuraloperator_fno

transform.layout: fftshift on all spatial dimensions except the last real-FFT dimension
transform.spectrum: last dimension has n//2+1 real-FFT coefficients; retain n_modes after the library setter adjusts the last mode
transform.inverse: torch.fft.irfftn(out_fft, s=mode_sizes, dim=spatial_dims, norm=fft_norm), with the documented Hermitian-symmetry path when enabled

baseline.training_contract: The official example trains on Darcy permeability-to-pressure pairs with H1 training loss and L2/H1 evaluation.

replacement_boundary.replace: Only the real forward/inverse FFT calls and their compatible spectral data movement inside SpectralConv.
preserve: FNO lifting, projection, skip connections, nonlinearities, channel contraction, mode truncation, and data processor.
rfftn half-spectrum shape, fftshift axes, forward normalization, output_shape/s argument, and Hermitian symmetry enforcement.
The same model parameters and checkpoint for baseline and treatment.
replacement_boundary.required_adapter: cuButterfly currently exposes mainly complex-to-complex FFT paths. Add an explicit real-FFT adapter for the half-spectrum and irfftn contract; do not set complex_data=true to avoid the adapter.
replacement_boundary.forbidden_shortcut: A C2C FNO run is not a valid baseline for this application.

quality_contract.reference: Run the unmodified pinned FNO with the same frozen checkpoint and preprocessed Darcy samples.
quality_contract.minimum_checks: Both resolutions must complete without shape/layout fallback; treatment-vs-reference relative L2 <= 1e-4 and max absolute difference <= 1e-4 in FP32, or the tolerance must be justified and frozen before timing.
quality_contract.application_quality: Report held-out Darcy error at 64x64 and 128x128 separately; keep 16x16/32x32 only as smoke evidence.

timing_contract.setup_ms: Import, model construction, checkpoint load, and data-processor setup; report separately.
timing_contract.primary_gpu_ms: GPU-resident complete FNO forward, including all FFT adapter launches, on preloaded device tensors after one correctness warmup; baseline and treatment use the same model and input.
timing_contract.host_io_ms: Dataset fetch, preprocess, host-to-device copy, postprocess, and device-to-host output; report separately and do not fold into the primary GPU metric.
timing_contract.steady_state_ms: Repeated primary_gpu_ms calls after setup and one correctness warmup; CUDA-event scope must be recorded.
timing_contract.training: Training time and checkpoint acquisition are excluded from inference timing and reported as preparation cost.

required: PyTorch compatible with the pinned neuraloperator requirements
resources.data: Use the verified CC-BY-4.0 Zenodo archives for 64x64 and 128x128; record extracted tensor hashes and archive hashes at run time.

blockers: The pinned repository contains no fixed 64x64 or 128x128 trained checkpoint; train once with the official DarcyDataset path or obtain an authorized checkpoint, then freeze its hash.
The 64x64/128x128 high-resolution training wrapper must be configured through the verified DarcyDataset API; the tutorial's load_darcy_flow_small helper remains a 16x16 training smoke path.
The cuButterfly real-FFT adapter and Hermitian/layout correctness are not implemented or validated in this preparation task.
No GPU application run or quality result exists yet.

entry_points.role: Pinned prefill, decode, and combined e2e benchmark harness.
Quantized and FP16 model classes and OnlineHadamard call sites.

baseline.name: pinned_quarot_online_hadamard
baseline.model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf as selected by the upstream e2e harness
baseline.precision: int4 weights/activations and int4 KV cache in the Quarot model path
baseline.hadamard: quarot.nn.OnlineHadamard -> matmul_hadU_cuda -> fast_hadamard_transform plus optional small hadK matrix
baseline.upstream_warning: e2e/benchmark.py constructs the quantized model under no_init_weights(), so its default performance path has random/uninitialized weights and is not a quality result.

replacement_boundary.replace: Only the power-of-two fast Hadamard transform call inside matmul_hadU_cuda.
preserve: get_hadK selection, hadK buffer and hadK @ input multiplication.
The exact 1/sqrt(n) normalization, contiguous/view semantics, dtype conversion, and transpose orientation.
Quantizer, Linear4bit/int4 GEMM, fused CUDA extension, flash attention, rotary embedding, and int4 KV cache.

llama2_7b_shape_contract.attention: OnlineHadamard is instantiated with num_heads=32, so the K=1 power-of-two path is used there.
llama2_7b_shape_contract.mlp_down_projection: intermediate_size=11008 is decomposed by get_hadK as K=172 and n/K=64; run cuButterfly FWHT on the 64-wide power-of-two subpath, then retain the original 172x172 hadK multiply.
llama2_7b_shape_contract.forbidden_shortcut: Do not zero-pad 11008 to a power of two, replace the 172x172 factor, or compare a different model class.

quality_contract.weights: Quality mode uses one authorized, frozen Llama-2-7B checkpoint for both variants. Performance mode uses one deterministically initialized random model state with seed 20261003, cloned into both variants.
quality_contract.data: Use the pinned QuaRot WikiText-2 raw validation path (wikitext-2-raw-v1), freeze dataset revision and tokenizer files, and record hashes before evaluation.
metrics: next-token logit relative error against pinned QuaRot baseline
greedy token agreement on a fixed seed
quality_contract.causal_comparison: The causal pair is the same model state with only the FWHT subpath replaced. Upstream int4-vs-FP16 numbers are not this comparison.
quality_contract.random_performance_claim: Random weights are valid for latency, launch, memory and trace comparisons only; no quality or perplexity claim is allowed.

timing_contract.setup_ms: Extension build, tokenizer/model load, quantized checkpoint load, and KV-cache allocation; report separately.
timing_contract.primary_gpu_ms: GPU-resident full-model prefill and decode loop with the same KV-cache behavior, all FWHT launches, logits/greedy output synchronization, and no host input/output in the timed interval; exclude checkpoint download and setup.
timing_contract.host_io_ms: Public tokenization/batch preparation, host-to-device input transfer, device-to-host logits or token collection, and postprocess; report separately and do not fold into the primary GPU metric.
timing_contract.steady_state_ms: Repeated GPU-resident prefill+decode calls after one correctness run; include all FWHT launches and their synchronization in the application path.
timing_contract.upstream_reference: The verified upstream syntax is python e2e/benchmark.py --batch_size B --prefill_seq_len S --decode_steps D. The E13 random-performance runner must freeze one initialized state before constructing the baseline and treatment.

resources.memory: Record peak allocation for both variants. Random initialization is explicit and reproducible; the upstream no_init_weights path is not sufficient.

blockers: Random-performance runner must initialize one deterministic state and clone it into baseline and treatment before any timing.
The causal adapter preserving K=172 x 64 decomposition, quantization, and GEMM is not implemented or validated in this task.

entry_points.role: Official CKKS regular bootstrapping setup, call, decrypt, and precision example.
Pinned regular_bootstrapping NTT call sites and stream propagation.
Pinned GPU-NTT implementation used by the CKKS path.

baseline.name: pinned_heongpu_gpu_ntt
baseline.application_boundary: The measured application operation is operators.regular_bootstrapping(C1, galois_key, relin_key), after the input ciphertext is prepared at the required maximum depth.
baseline.ntt_calls: The baseline includes every GPU-NTT dispatch reached by regular_bootstrapping: the direct GPU_INTT, mod_raise, and GPU_NTT_Inplace path before CoeffToSlot plus any nested coeff_to_slot, matrix/key-switch, exp_scaled, and slot_to_coeff dispatches. The complete pinned call trace is the baseline and must be audited rather than reduced to the two direct calls.

contract.roots: Forward and inverse root tables are generated per RNS modulus from primitive roots for N and stored in the context.
contract.inverse_scale: context_->n_inverse_ supplies per-modulus N inverse to GPU_INTT.
contract.stream: ExecutionOptions.stream_ is passed to both NTT configs and all surrounding kernels; default is cudaStreamDefault.
contract.order: The API exposes ring/layout but does not make a separate natural-order promise; freeze the observed order by comparing each direction with the pinned GPU-NTT reference before replacement.

replacement_boundary.replace: Every compatible GPU-NTT dispatch reached by the complete regular_bootstrapping call graph, with one word64 call per RNS modulus where needed; unsupported layouts remain explicitly native or blocked.
preserve: X^N+1 negacyclic semantics, each modulus and root table, RNS limb ordering, per-polynomial layout, no zero padding, inverse N scaling, and the caller stream.
ModRaise, CoeffToSlot, EvalMod, SlotToCoeff, key switching, ciphertext metadata, and all key material.
The complete bootstrapping call as the timed application operation.
replacement_boundary.arithmetic_boundary: cuButterfly word64 supports moduli below 2^63 only. The adapter must handle each HEonGPU RNS limb separately; generic multi-limb arithmetic is out of scope.
replacement_boundary.stream_boundary: A replacement launch on a different stream or an implicit device synchronize is invalid; stream identity and dependency ordering must be checked.

dispatch_coverage.call_graph: regular_bootstrapping -> coeff_to_slot -> multiply_matrix or multiply_matrix_less_memory -> exp_scaled (twice) -> slot_to_coeff
dispatch_coverage.scope_rule: Instrument the complete call, including nested matrix, key-switch, exponentiation, and transform helpers; a top-level two-call replacement is not full coverage.

dispatch_families.observed_role: Coefficient-domain recovery and inverse transforms in CKKS helper paths.
dispatch_families.initial_policy: Replace only after per-polynomial word64 root/order equivalence; otherwise retain the pinned HEonGPU implementation and count the native dispatch.

dispatch_families.observed_role: Forward transforms for raised ciphertexts and CKKS helper paths.
dispatch_families.initial_policy: Candidate for cuButterfly replacement when modulus, layout, root, inverse-scale, and stream contracts match; record every native and replacement call.

dispatch_families.observed_role: Ordered RNS/layout variants used by HEonGPU arithmetic helpers.
dispatch_families.initial_policy: Native-retained or unsupported until ordered layout and per-limb mapping are audited; no silent fallback is allowed.

dispatch_coverage.excluded_dispatches: SmallForwardNTT and SmallInverseNTT are device-local helper kernels for HEonGPU bootstrapping internals, not a cuButterfly GPU-NTT replacement target in this regular CKKS dispatch audit; record if a future call trace reaches them.
dispatch_coverage.required_record: For each payload, report call counts by family as replacement, native_retained, unsupported, and total; report the exact call trace or instrumentation hash.
dispatch_coverage.claim_rule: If any required compatible dispatch is unsupported or unaccounted for, label the run a partial NTT ablation and do not call it a complete replacement.

payload_policy.rule: N=4096 is an insecure source demonstration and may only smoke-test the adapter. N=16384 is a resource-exploration candidate, not a selected main case; select a main payload only after a safe security level, valid multiplicative depth, complete Q/P chain, and memory audit freeze a possibly different N.

payloads.coeff_modulus_bit_sizes: The exact 31-element Q/P lists in the pinned official example.
payloads.resource_note: Officially documented as a functional but insecure demonstration parameter set.

payloads.coeff_modulus_bit_sizes: Must be frozen from a validated CKKS bootstrapping parameter set; do not copy the N=4096 list without a depth/noise audit.
payloads.resource_note: The pinned source warns that bootstrapping is memory intensive and was tested on an RTX 4090 with 24 GB; check available memory before any GPU launch.

quality_contract.reference: Pinned HEonGPU GPU-NTT for the same context and ciphertext, with replacement disabled.
checks: decoded CKKS precision statistics after regular bootstrapping
quality_contract.application_quality: The decrypted message must remain within a frozen CKKS precision tolerance and the treatment must not change the bootstrap output contract. Key generation, encryption, and decryption are quality/setup checks, not part of the bootstrap timing claim.

timing_contract.setup_ms: Context generation, bootstrapping parameter generation, key generation, plaintext encode, encryption, and input leveling; report separately.
timing_contract.primary_gpu_ms: The complete regular_bootstrapping call from the prepared device-resident ciphertext to the returned refreshed ciphertext, including every compatible NTT dispatch, all CKKS stages, the cuButterfly adapter launches, and required stream synchronization; exclude host input/output and setup.
timing_contract.host_io_ms: Ciphertext preparation, host/device transfers, decrypt, decode, and result collection; report separately and do not fold into the primary GPU metric.
timing_contract.steady_state_ms: Repeated complete bootstrap calls after one correctness run, with the same stream, keys, and context; record synchronization protocol and dispatch coverage.
timing_contract.not_claimed: This is an application-level CKKS bootstrapping workflow, not a claim of a complete FHE service, model, or user-facing workload.

required: HEonGPU dependencies including GPU-NTT, GPU-FFT, RNGonGPU, and RMM
resources.memory_policy: The source initializes a device memory pool at 0.9 of GPU memory and allows 0.95 maximum; do not run blindly on a shared device.

blockers: No HEonGPU build or GPU execution was performed in this preparation task.
The per-RNS word64 adapter, root/order equivalence, and stream-safe integration are not implemented or validated.
No safe main CKKS payload is fixed: N=16384 is only a resource-exploration candidate, and its security level, depth, complete Q/P chain, and memory feasibility remain pending.
No CKKS precision result exists yet.

measurement_protocol.ordering: Balanced baseline/treatment order within each trial, frozen before reading timings. Record every call and its order.
measurement_protocol.primary_latency: Synchronized wall time of the complete declared model or bootstrap operation on GPU-resident inputs. Include per-call adapter work, allocations, CPU dispatch, and required synchronization. Exclude compilation, reusable setup, and host dataset/token input preparation.
measurement_protocol.secondary_device_span: CUDA-event span is valid only if the ending caller-stream event joins every participating stream. Keep it separate from wall time and profiler diagnostics.
measurement_protocol.state: Each invocation starts from equivalent input, ciphertext, and KV state. Any per-request reset/allocation required by the application is included identically in both timed variants.
measurement_protocol.aggregation: Report each trial median and the median of the three trial medians, raw samples, paired speedup, peak memory, and quality. Do not pool the three applications into one speedup.
measurement_protocol.quality_gate: Freeze checkpoint/data/parameter hashes and numerical tolerances, then validate before timing. Record NTT native/replaced dispatch coverage and partial-adapter limitations.
measurement_protocol.profiling: Use separate diagnostic runs for butterfly attribution, adapter cost, launches, and memory traffic. Do not substitute summed profiler kernel time for complete application latency.
measurement_protocol.resources: Record the GPU UUID, model, memory capacity, software build, compiler policy, and telemetry. Reuse the existing exclusive-device measurement discipline. This preparation script starts no jobs.

cross_application_rules.comparison: Report each application separately; do not average FFT/FWHT/NTT ratios into one application claim.
cross_application_rules.timing: Separate setup, first correct use, steady-state application time, and quality checks. Do not include compilation or model/key downloads in steady-state timing.
cross_application_rules.baseline: Use the pinned application's real default contract. A semantic downgrade to fit an existing cuButterfly path invalidates the comparison.
cross_application_rules.result_language: Until the blockers are cleared, use prepared, pending, or unavailable; never use completed, measured, speedup, or quality result.
cross_application_rules.external_assets: Record model/data/license authorization and SHA-256 for every externally acquired asset before running.
